lan.title: Send to phone
lan.pick: Pick the audiobooks to send. Your phone downloads them over your own network — nothing leaves it.
lan.staleHint: Re-render needed means the audio no longer matches the chapters — re-render the cast before sending it.
lan.empty: No audiobooks are available to send yet. Create an audiobook first.
lan.scan: Scan this with the txtCaster app on your phone. Keep this window open.
lan.safety: Safety code {code|ltr} — confirm it on the phone
lan.consumed: This code was already used to pair, so it can't be scanned again. Show a new QR code to pair another phone.
lan.locked: Too many failed attempts to pair. Show a new QR code to keep going.
lan.firewall: Phone can't connect? Your computer's firewall may be blocking local connections for txtCaster.
lan.stopConfirm: Your phone will keep what it already received and can resume later.
lan.missing: '{title|bdi}' is missing on disk — it was skipped.
lan.noNetwork: This computer isn't connected to a network. Join the same Wi-Fi as your phone and try again.
lan.portBlocked: Couldn't open a connection for the phone. Another program may be blocking it — try again.

review.scoredNoneNotice.one: The accuracy check finished without scoring any of {count|n} sentence, so it says nothing about whether this cast is right — treat it as not run, not as a pass. This usually means the checker itself could not run.
review.scoredNoneNotice.other: The accuracy check finished without scoring any of {count|n} sentences, so it says nothing about whether this cast is right — treat it as not run, not as a pass. This usually means the checker itself could not run.

review.uncheckedNotice.one: The accuracy check did not run on {count|n} sentence — they were never read back, so nothing here says whether they are right. Re-run the accuracy check to score them.
review.uncheckedNotice.other: The accuracy check did not run on {count|n} sentences — they were never read back, so nothing here says whether they are right. Re-run the accuracy check to score them.

review.block.failed: This cast failed, so there is nothing to re-record yet.
review.block.cancelled: This cast was cancelled, so there is nothing to re-record yet.
review.block.paused: Resume the cast first — editing needs a finished cast.
review.block.running: This cast is still running. You can edit its sentences once it finishes.

review.staleExport.one: This cast's audio no longer matches its chapters. Re-render it to bring the audio and the chapter marks back in step.
review.staleExport.other: {count|n} exports from this cast no longer match its chapters. Re-render it to bring the audio and the chapter marks back in step.

review.empty: Nothing to review — no sentence was flagged or edited.
review.editHint: Edit this sentence and re-record it
review.checkOffHint: This cast ran without the accuracy check, so only edited sentences are listed.
